text: 2018 is the first year of operations for CreateTO. The purpose of this report is to provide the Board of Directors with quarterly updates of the company’s financial status in accordance with good governance practice. The third quarter of 2018 unaudited financial statements have been prepared for information purposes only.

The Board of Directors of CreateTO: 1. Directed that the confidential information contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (November 27, 2018) from the Chief Financial Officer, CreateTO remain confidential in its entirety, as it contains financial information that belongs to the Board of Directors of CreateTO and has monetary value or potential monetary value.
